school_name: State University of New York at Cortland
title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named campus places that support studying, recreation, programs, or cultural activity.

cards.title: Corey Union
cards.subtitle: Campus activities, meeting rooms, study areas and services
cards.notes: Use the building as a practical meet-up point: check the campus calendar, visit a student organization, or settle into one of its study areas.
cards.short_summary: A student-services hub with space for meetings, programs, studying and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland says Corey Union houses meeting rooms, offices, study areas, dining, student clubs and the Student Government Association.
cards.source_title: Campus Activities and Corey Union | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: Building services and room use may vary by event or office.

cards.title: Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Research help, technology and individual or group study
cards.notes: Choose a workspace that fits your task, then use the Research Help Desk or online librarian chat when you need help finding sources.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines research support with study rooms, carrels and shared seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Memorial Library offers group study rooms, study carrels, the Bookmark Cafe and other spaces, and provides research help to the SUNY Cortland community.
cards.access_notes: Library spaces have differing noise expectations; consult the library map and policies.

cards.title: Bookmark Cafe
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library’s first-floor cafe entrance and study area
cards.notes: Enter from Prospect Terrace for a study-area route into the library, and use it as a starting point before heading to a quieter floor.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor library area that connects the cafe entrance with study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland’s library map says the Bookmark Cafe entrance leads to a study area and the Advisement and Transition Office.
cards.access_notes: The Bookmark Cafe entrance does not have a push-to-enter option, according to the library accessibility map.

cards.title: Memorial Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Second floor of Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a project idea and confirm available equipment or support before visiting; the Makerspace sits among second-floor open seating and computing resources.
cards.short_summary: A named making area integrated into the library’s collaborative second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland’s library map lists the Makerspace on Memorial Library’s second floor alongside open seating study areas and the Computer Applications Lab.
cards.source_title: Library Map Text Descriptions | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: The second floor permits noise and is typically a moderate-noise area.

cards.title: Teaching Materials Center
cards.subtitle: First floor of Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use this named library destination when your coursework calls for teaching resources, then pair the visit with nearby first-floor open seating or research help.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library center for teaching materials within a larger study and support zone.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland lists the Teaching Materials Center among Memorial Library’s spaces and places it on the first floor in its map description.
cards.source_title: Library Map Text Descriptions | SUNY Cortland
cards.access_notes: The first floor allows noise in most areas.

cards.title: Student Life Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation, social spaces and a dining hall near campus center
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the facility you need, such as the track, climbing wall, gymnasium, pool or fitness areas, and follow recreation rules.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose recreation building with fitness features, social space and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland says the Student Life Center includes a pool, gymnasium, running track, weight room, climbing wall, group exercise room and social spaces.
cards.access_notes: Recreation access and program availability may be subject to campus recreation policies.

cards.title: Holsten Pool
cards.subtitle: Park Center aquatic facility
cards.notes: Check campus recreation availability before going, then use the Park Center layout to locate the first-floor locker rooms and second-floor spectator access.
cards.short_summary: A named Park Center pool with dedicated spectator and locker-room locations.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland identifies Holsten Pool in Park Center, with locker rooms on the first floor and spectator seating accessed from the second floor.
cards.access_notes: Availability for swimming or spectating depends on the facility schedule and event use.

cards.title: Dowd Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor of Dowd Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Look for the current exhibition before your visit, then enter Dowd Fine Arts Center from the most convenient building entrance to reach the gallery.
cards.short_summary: A campus exhibition space housed in Dowd Fine Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland says Dowd Gallery is on the first floor of Dowd Fine Arts Center and can be accessed from any entrance to the building.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition access may depend on the gallery’s current schedule.

cards.title: Brooks Museum
cards.subtitle: Moffett Center, Room 2126
cards.notes: Pair a museum stop with nearby campus buildings, and use the room location in Moffett Center to find the collection before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A named campus museum located in Moffett Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland identifies Brooks Museum as a museum venue in Moffett Center, Room 2126.
cards.access_notes: Confirm museum access or scheduled programming before visiting.

cards.title: Park Center Alumni Arena
cards.subtitle: First-floor Park Center athletic and event venue
cards.notes: Check the university events calendar or athletics schedule before going, and use the surrounding Park Center lots only in accordance with posted parking rules.
cards.short_summary: A large Park Center venue used for athletics as well as performances and events.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland lists Park Center Alumni Arena as both an athletic facility and a performance and event space on Park Center’s first floor.
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on the scheduled event and its admission or attendance requirements.
